headword: {連帯|れんたい}{保証人|ほしょうにん}
reading: れんたいほしょうにん

definitions.explanation: A person who agrees to take on the same level of responsibility as the primary debtor or tenant, often required for apartment rentals or loans in Japan.

examples.japanese: {連帯|れんたい}{保証人|ほしょうにん}が{見|み}つからない。
examples.english: I can't find a joint guarantor.

examples.japanese: {賃貸|ちんたい}{契約|けいやく}には{連帯|れんたい}{保証人|ほしょうにん}が{必要|ひつよう}だ。
examples.english: A joint guarantor is required for the rental contract.

examples.japanese: {親|おや}に{連帯|れんたい}{保証人|ほしょうにん}になってもらった。
examples.english: I had my parents become my joint guarantors.

notes:
{連帯|れんたい}{保証人|ほしょうにん} is commonly required when renting apartments in Japan. The guarantor has the same legal obligation as the tenant to pay rent. For those without a suitable guarantor, {保証|ほしょう}{会社|がいしゃ} (guarantor companies) offer an alternative.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {連帯|れんたい}{保証人|ほしょうにん}になる (to become a joint guarantor)
- {連帯|れんたい}{保証人|ほしょうにん}を{立|た}てる (to provide a joint guarantor)
- {連帯|れんたい}{保証人|ほしょうにん}{不要|ふよう} (no guarantor required)

RELATED TERMS:
- {保証|ほしょう}{会社|がいしゃ}: guarantor company
- {敷金|しききん}: security deposit
- {礼金|れいきん}: key money
